plan_summary: Add a ledger-backed idempotency guard to the retry worker and short-circuit duplicate job ids.

file_change_proposal.description: Consult the ledger before executing; return the recorded result on a duplicate job id.
Add a unique constraint on job_id and an insert-or-get helper.

criteria_map.criterion: The retry worker must reject a duplicate job id and return the result already recorded for it.
The idempotency guard records each job id exactly once in the ledger.
A replayed request produces no second side effect and logs a skip.
